task: Terrain-Grounded Imagination, HUPHY perceptive velocity tracking on rough terrain
what: HUPHY LegOnly biped (12 motors, 2-RSU AB ankle) walks at a commanded body velocity over stairs, boxes, slopes, tilted tiles and stepping stones, using a height map around the predicted footholds.
target_pos_rad: target = offset_rad + scale_rad_per_unit * action, then clipped to clip_rad (the action itself is NOT clipped; last_action is the raw value, clipped to +-10 in the observation only)

observations.definition: Linear velocity of the pelvis (base_link frame origin) in the pelvis frame (+x forward, +y left, +z up), from the state estimator. Not delayed in training.
0.2 x IMU angular velocity [rad/s] in the IMU frame (site imu_in_base: base_link orientation, pos (-0.000001, 0.007078, -0.0695) m). Noise was added before the scale. Delayed with the encoders.
Direction of gravity in the IMU frame; (0, 0, -1) when upright. Not the accelerometer reading.
Velocity command (vx, vy, wz) in the pelvis frame. Clipped to command.range by the deploy code.
Encoder angles minus default_pose_rad of the previous control step (after a reset: the current frame).
Encoder angles minus default_pose_rad of this control step.
Raw network output of the previous control step (before scale / offset / clip), clipped to +-10. Zeros after a reset.
Per foot (R, then L): FPM foothold (x, y) in the pelvis yaw frame, then the n x n patch values clip(z_pelvis - z_terrain - 0.5, -1, 1); see foothold_scan and height_scan.py.

fpm.output: footholds (R x, R y, L x, L y) [m] in the pelvis yaw frame: where each foot is predicted to land next
fpm.input: base_lin_vel 3, gyro 3 (no scale), projected_gravity 3, command 3, motor_pos_prev 12, motor_pos 12; noise-free in training

foothold_scan.frame: horizontal grid centred on the pelvis, rotated by the pelvis yaw only
foothold_scan.patch_order: k = n a + b, node (clip(ax + a - n//2), clip(ay + b - n//2)), (ax, ay) the node nearest to the foothold
foothold_scan.train_source: global height map, 0.04 m cells, nearest cell

command.training_profile: new command every 10 s; heading-controlled envs turn towards a random heading (wz from the heading error); 10 % of the envs get zero command

frames.body: +x forward, +y left, +z up (pelvis / base_link = IMU frame)
frames.joint_sign: positive joint angle = right-hand rotation about the joint axis in motor_params.json; L joints are the mirror of R (q_L = -q_R in the mirrored pose)
frames.zero: joint angle 0 = the zero of the MJCF model the policy was trained on; the default pose is NOT zero

notes: actions, encoders and last_action use the same 12-motor order (model order).
both ONNX graphs contain their input normalization.
the policy reads the crank motor angles, never the passive ankle angles.

policy.how: observations of the sequence below; actions = torch actor of the checkpoint (raw, before scale / offset / clip). Feed obs to the ONNX as is (float32).

fpm.how: FPM inputs of the sequence below; footholds = torch FPM of the checkpoint, (R x, R y, L x, L y) m

sequence.how: sim2sim course stairs:0.10, command (0.6, 0.0, 0.0), sensor noise off, steps 250-265 (on the stairs). Replay from 'start' (internal state: previous encoder frame - default pose, previous raw action) with height=RobotGrid(robot_grid); targets = clip(default + 0.25 a) with a from the torch actor of the checkpoint on the training-pipeline observation.
